note: Refresh Rust and Java dependencies and support Rust 1.99 Clippy diagnostics. Replace tokio-cron-scheduler (and its second croner/chrono-tz/uuid/tracing tree) with a built-in tokio scheduler driven by croner 4; the compile-time #[cron] validator and the runtime scheduler now share one parser (vespera_core::cron), removing the croner 3/4 mismatch (compile-time-accepted expressions could be rejected at runtime). vespera-bridge now targets Spring Boot 4.1 / Spring Framework 7 / JUnit 6 / Gradle 9.8. axum is now depended on with default-features off (its tracing/tower-log features are no longer forced on; vespera_inprocess drops 27 transitive crates) and vespera_inprocess declares the tokio sync feature it uses. BREAKING: vespera::tokio_cron_scheduler re-export removed (use vespera::cron); vespera-bridge requires Spring Boot 4. vespera now depends on chrono without default features (serde + now): iana-time-zone and the windows-core proc-macro stack are no longer compiled, and chrono's Local clock (the clock feature) is no longer enabled by vespera itself; re-enable it in your own manifest if you use vespera::chrono::Local. vespera_macro no longer compiles a serde Value (de)serializer copy of the OpenAPI types (export_app! namespacing round-trips through JSON text) and schema! borrows its schema maps.
